summary: HF Foods Group Inc. filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, announcing the adoption of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) via a Preferred Stock Rights Agreement with Equiniti Trust Company. The board declared a dividend of one right per share, exercisable at $9.55 per one-thousandth of a Series AA Preferred share. The plan is triggered at 15% ownership without board approval, imposing a penalty to deter unsolicited takeover efforts. This is a defensive governance measure, not a special situation event.
